description: This is a unit test class for the BasketService in the eShopOnWeb application. It tests the TransferBasketAsync method to ensure correct behavior when transferring basket items from an anonymous basket to a user basket, including cases for existing and non-existing baskets, as well as deletion of anonymous baskets after transfer.

classes.name: TransferBasket
classes.description: This is the unit test class containing multiple test methods validating the behavior of BasketService.TransferBasketAsync method.

methods.name: InvokesBasketRepositoryFirstOrDefaultAsyncOnceIfAnonymousBasketNotExists
methods.description: Tests that FirstOrDefaultAsync is invoked once when anonymous basket does not exist.

methods.name: TransferAnonymousBasketItemsWhilePreservingExistingUserBasketItems
methods.description: Tests transferring items from anonymous to existing user basket, ensuring items are combined correctly.

methods.name: RemovesAnonymousBasketAfterUpdatingUserBasket
methods.description: Tests that the anonymous basket is deleted after transfer when applicable.

methods.name: CreatesNewUserBasketIfNotExists
methods.description: Tests creation of a new basket for a user if it does not already exist.
